label: Preserve existing log retention values during split

execute.description: Copy existing per-tenant retention and permanent mode to login and event
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."operation_log_settings" SET "loginRetentionDays" = "retentionDays", "eventRetentionDays" = "retentionDays" WHERE "retentionDays" IS NOT NULL AND "loginRetentionDays" IS NULL AND "eventRetentionDays" IS NULL

precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_constraint" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."connamespace" WHERE ("c"."conname" = $1 AND "n"."nspname" = $2 AND "c"."conrelid" = to_regclass($3))) AS "result"

execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."operation_log_settings" ADD CONSTRAINT "operation_log_settings_event_retention_rule_1680dd3c" CHECK ("eventRetentionDays" IS NULL OR "eventRetentionDays" = 0 OR "eventRetentionDays" BETWEEN 30 AND 3650)
